behavioralRed.result: The healthy Vitest runner failed only on the explicit structured-logger skeleton, absent build/service labels and probe requests incorrectly entering SLO metrics.

After excluding the sandbox-only Helm execution denial, the healthy render failed only on missing ServiceMonitor, API metrics port, five alert rules, dashboard queries and the standalone validator skeleton.

gates.summary: 2 files and 5 tests pass for bounded metrics labels, probe exclusion, stable request IDs and recursive credential/control-character sanitization.
Conditional monitoring resources, internal scrape path, five alerts, dashboard metrics and standalone validation pass.
Server TypeScript check passes without diagnostics.
Complete server regression passes 59 files and 359 ordinary tests; 50 separately owned exact-MySQL cases are skipped.

gates.summary: The production render passes the independent observability validator.

contracts.metrics: bounded method, normalized route, status class and service labels; health/readiness excluded from request SLOs
contracts.logging: one sanitized structured event per request with no body, authorization, cookie, literal URL, query or secret value
contracts.monitoring: optional ServiceMonitor, exact five alerts and sidecar-loadable dashboard constrained by release and namespace

releaseBoundary.note: P6-T3 proves local application and rendered monitoring contracts only; it does not claim registry or immutable release completion.
